newsitem.title: FINLAND: SISU-RENAULT JV SEES FIM 500 MLN SALES/YR.
newsitem.headline: SISU-RENAULT JV SEES FIM 500 MLN SALES/YR.

text.p: A joint venture between Finnish state-owned truck maker Oy Sisu Ab and French vehicles group Renault V.I. SA aims for net sales of 500 million markka in 1997, Sisu said on Monday.
"The company's net sales target for this year is about 500 million markka," Sisu said in a statement.

In line with a June 1996 preliminary agreement, Sisu and Renault on Monday sealed a deal on joint operations in truck sales and service and components, and on the joint venture RS Hansa Auto Oy, Sisu said.
Under the agreement, the 50-50 owned company will be in charge of Sisu and Renault truck sales in Finland, the Baltic countries and nearby parts of Russia, the company said.
Also under the deal, Renault will supply truck components to Sisu, and make its international sales network available to Sisu truck exports, Sisu said.

"For Sisu, an alliance with the world's third largest utility vehicle manufacturer means strong support to develop operations and improve the competitivenss of the Finnish truck industry at home and in exports," Jukka Niemi, managing director of the new joint venture, said in the statement.
The Helsinki-based joint venture will have 280 employees and 15 service centres around Finland, Sisu said.
